2	"""
3	compressed_layer.py — S493/S494, compressed-prover steps 2 & 3.
4	
5	Step 1 (compressed_prover_mult_trace.py) built, in isolation, the batched
6	multiplication-trace sum-check that certifies a small-side value lookup
7	C = sum_d eq(rho,d) S~(floor(X/(d p))) with a polylog verifier that never
8	divides. Step 2 (S493) integrated it into ONE large-side Lucy layer over the
9	compressed O(sqrt x)-size state. Step 3 (S494, THIS file) adds the SMALL-side
10	layer and CHAINS all K layers into an end-to-end verification of pi(x) over
11	the compressed state -- the gate to a production Õ(sqrt x) prover (the demo
12	prover of lucy_dp_verification materializes the full 2^n table, Õ(x^{3/2})).
13	
14	The compressed Lucy_Hedgehog key-value DP, V = floor(sqrt x), nb = bits(V):
15	  small[v]  = S(v)              value-addressed,  v in [1, V]   (index = value)
16	  large[e]  = S(floor(x/(e+1))) d-addressed,      e in [0, V-1] (index e = d-1)
17	and pi(x) = large[0] after sieving by every prime <= V. Both sides are padded
18	to the nb-cube of size 2^nb (V < 2^nb <= 2V); padding entries are 0 every
19	layer.
20	
21	The layer recurrence S_i(w) = S_{i-1}(w) - [w>=p^2]*(S_{i-1}(floor(w/p))-(i-1)).
22	
23	LARGE side (key w = floor(x/(e+1)), step 2): floor(w/p)=floor(x/((e+1)p)).
24	With ep=(e+1)p, ep<=V is an AFFINE large-index map e->ep-1 (long-division
25	automaton waff_eval, no trace); ep>V is a SMALL value looked up by value
26	WITHOUT the verifier dividing -- step 1's trace primitive. Phase-A folds
27	validity AND the p^2 gate into ONE threshold B(e)=[e<=Bcut]; phase-B splits
28	g1=g1_aff+g1_trace and dispatches per key. Outputs: a large point-claim
29	(line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a SMALL point-claim s_B@r_B (carried).
30	
31	SMALL side (key w = v, step 3, NEW): floor(w/p)=floor(v/p) stays ENTIRELY
32	within the small side (value->value) -- the existing division automaton
33	w_div_eval / lucy_dp_verification.verify_layer phase-B over the nb-cube. The
34	gate is a BAND B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V]: the upper bound [v<=V] is load-bearing in
35	general (it keeps the recurrence off the padding columns whose update would
36	otherwise corrupt the zero padding); when V=2^nb-1 (x=2^n-1, n even) the band
37	collapses to the bare comparator [v>=p^2] of the NEXT-ACTION note -- so the
38	"comparator suffices, no validity fold" claim holds exactly in the no-padding
39	case and the band is its general-V refinement. The small layer emits TWO
40	point-claims on S_{i-1}^small: s1@r_v (the v itself) and s2@r_u (floor(v/p)).
41	
42	CHAIN (step 3). Per layer we carry a width-2 claim vector
43	(large-claim about S_i^large, small-claim about S_i^small). Start: layer K
44	has only large-claim S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) (no S_K^small is referenced).
45	Running layer i:
46	  * large_reduce consumes the large-claim -> a large-claim about S_{i-1}^large
47	    AND a small-claim s_B about S_{i-1}^small (its trace region);
48	  * small_reduce (skipped at i=K) consumes the small-claim -> two small-claims
49	    about S_{i-1}^small.
50	The same-table claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B + the two from small_reduce)
51	are folded by sequential LINE restriction into one; the large-claim is its own
52	line-batch. Base: open S_0 on both sides. Soundness: a self-consistent liar
53	(corrupt one DP entry, re-propagate upward) is caught at the layer where the
54	corruption meets the honest layer below -- phase-A's round-1 sum on the honest
55	S_{i-1} tables disagrees with the corrupted carried claim.
56	
57	Leaf openings of committed tables (incl. the two S_0 bases) are closed here by
58	direct MLE evaluation -- the stand-in for the polynomial-commitment / outer-
59	protocol line batching, identical to steps 1-2's scope. The S_0 bases have no
60	cheap closed form (floor(x/(e+1)) on the large side; padded max(v-1,0) on the
61	small side), so they are opened directly: a ONE-TIME O(sqrt x), within the
62	Õ(sqrt x) budget. The reduction logic is real: every per-layer check is a
63	genuine MLE-consistency test against true wiring (eq, band/threshold
64	comparators, division & affine automata); honest accepts, every cheating
65	prover is rejected.
66	
67	Sizes (the point of the line): small & large cubes 2^nb ~ sqrt x; the trace
68	constraint test runs on the e-cube with Lv=O(log x) bit tables -> prover
69	Õ(sqrt x); verifier touches only nb-length points and O(nb)-state automata
70	(except waff's O(nb*p), delegatable to O(nb*log p)).
71	
72	What would falsify this: the compressed DP disagreeing with a sieve; an honest
73	layer or honest chain rejected; output/base claims not equal to the true MLEs;
74	any cheating prover (corrupted DP claim/table, wrong region split, wrong trace
75	quotient, wrong affine image, corrupted small-side wiring, tampered cross-side
76	carry, wrong claimed pi) accepted above the field soundness bound; or verifier
77	work scaling with 2^n instead of nb.
78	
79	Usage:
80	  python3 compressed_layer.py --selftest
81	  python3 compressed_layer.py --n 12 --cheat-trials 20
82	  python3 compressed_layer.py --bench
83	"""

100	def compressed_lucy(x):
101	    """Return (primes, small_layers, large_layers).
102	    small_layers[i][v] = S_i(v) for v in [0,V];  small_layers[0] = S_0.
103	    large_layers[i][e] = S_i(floor(x/(e+1))) for e in [0,V).
104	    pi(x) = large_layers[-1][0]."""
105	    V = isqrt(x)
106	    small = [max(v - 1, 0) for v in range(V + 1)]
107	    large = [(x // (e + 1)) - 1 for e in range(V)]
108	    small_layers, large_layers, primes = [small[:]], [large[:]], []
109	    for p in range(2, V + 1):
110	        if small[p] - small[p - 1] > 0:                     # p is prime
111	            primes.append(p)
112	            sp, p2 = small[p - 1], p * p
113	            ns, nl = small[:], large[:]
114	            for v in range(p2, V + 1):
115	                ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
116	            for e in range(V):
117	                val = x // (e + 1)
118	                if val >= p2:
119	                    ep = (e + 1) * p
120	                    sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
121	                    nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
122	            small, large = ns, nl
123	            small_layers.append(small[:])
124	            large_layers.append(large[:])
125	    return primes, small_layers, large_layers

128	def corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers, lg_layers, x, i0):
129	    """Self-consistent liar: corrupt large_layers[i0][0] (the pi-carrying
130	    slot, = S_{i0}(x)) and re-propagate layers i0+1..K so the corrupted tables
131	    are mutually consistent. The small side is unchanged (its recurrence never
132	    reads the large side), so the corruption is large-only and must be caught
133	    at layer i0 where it meets the honest layer i0-1 below."""
134	    V = isqrt(x)
135	    K = len(primes)
136	    sm = [s[:] for s in sm_layers]
137	    lg = [l[:] for l in lg_layers]
138	    lg[i0][0] = lg[i0][0] + 1
139	    small, large = sm[i0][:], lg[i0][:]
140	    for j in range(i0 + 1, K + 1):
141	        p = primes[j - 1]
142	        sp, p2 = small[p - 1], p * p
143	        ns, nl = small[:], large[:]
144	        for v in range(p2, V + 1):
145	            ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
146	        for e in range(V):
147	            val = x // (e + 1)
148	            if val >= p2:
149	                ep = (e + 1) * p
150	                sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
151	                nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
152	        small, large = ns, nl
153	        sm[j], lg[j] = small[:], large[:]
154	    return sm, lg

161	def le_eval(r, M, n):
162	    """MLE of [e <= M] on n-bit e at point r. O(n)."""
163	    if M < 0:
164	        return 0
165	    if M >= (1 << n) - 1:
166	        return 1
167	    return (Q + 1 - ge_const_eval(r, M + 1, n)) % Q
168	
169	
170	def band_eval(r, lo, hi, n):
171	    """MLE of [lo <= e <= hi].  [lo<=e<=hi] = [e<=hi] - [e<=lo-1] pointwise,
172	    and the MLE is linear over that pointwise difference. O(n).  An EMPTY band
173	    (lo > hi, e.g. the small-side gate when p^2 > V) is the all-zero indicator,
174	    whose MLE is 0 -- and le(hi)-le(lo-1) is NOT 0 there, so guard it."""
175	    if lo > hi:
176	        return 0
177	    return (le_eval(r, hi, n) - le_eval(r, lo - 1, n)) % Q
178	
179	
180	def waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, n):
181	    """MLE of the affine-region wiring W_aff(e, e') = [e <= ecut] * [e' = p*e
182	    + (p-1)] at (r_v over e, r_u over e').  e' = p*e+(p-1) <=> floor(e'/p)=e
183	    AND e' mod p = p-1, so a long-division automaton on e' (state = running
184	    remainder in [0,p)) whose emitted quotient bits must equal e, accepting
185	    on final remainder p-1, crossed with a 3-state comparator e<=ecut.
186	    Bits MSB-first. VERIFIER: O(n*p)."""
187	    st = {(0, 0): 1}                       # (remainder, cmp) -> weight; cmp 0=eq 1=gt 2=lt
188	    for j in range(n):
189	        cbit = (ecut >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1
190	        wv = [(Q + 1 - int(r_v[j])) % Q, int(r_v[j]) % Q]   # e bit
191	        wu = [(Q + 1 - int(r_u[j])) % Q, int(r_u[j]) % Q]   # e' bit
192	        new = {}
193	        for (rem, cmp), w in st.items():
194	            if w == 0:
195	                continue
196	            for epb in (0, 1):
197	                t = 2 * rem + epb
198	                qb, rem2 = divmod(t, p)
199	                if qb > 1:                 # quotient bit out of range -> dead
200	                    continue
201	                cmp2 = (cmp if cmp != 0 else
202	                        (1 if qb > cbit else 2 if qb < cbit else 0))
203	                wgt = w * wu[epb] % Q * wv[qb] % Q          # eb := qb (forced)
204	                key = (rem2, cmp2)
205	                new[key] = (new.get(key, 0) + wgt) % Q
206	        st = new
207	    return sum(w for (rem, cmp), w in st.items()
208	               if rem == p - 1 and cmp in (0, 2)) % Q       # e <= ecut
209

215	def verify_affine_region(S_large, r_v, claimed, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
216	                         cheat=False):
217	    """g1_aff = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) S_large((e+1)p-1).  Routed by image
218	    index e': g1_aff = sum_{e'} Waff[e'] S_large(e').  Returns (ok, r_u, s2)."""
219	    Dml = 1 << nb
220	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
221	    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
222	    Waff = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
223	    for e in range(ecut + 1):
224	        ep1 = (e + 1) * p - 1
225	        if ep1 < Dml:
226	            Waff[ep1] = (int(Waff[ep1]) + int(eqrv[e])) % Q
227	    if cheat:                                               # wrong affine image
228	        bad = (p) % Dml
229	        Waff[bad] = (int(Waff[bad]) + 1) % Q
230	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
231	    okB, r_u, finalB, scal = sumcheck(claimed,
232	                                      {"W": Waff.copy(), "S": S_large.copy()},
233	                                      [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
234	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
235	    if not okB:
236	        return False, None, None
237	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
238	    waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb)
239	    s2 = scal["S"]
240	    ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q and s2 == mle_eval(S_large, r_u)
241	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
242	    return ok, r_u, s2

245	def verify_trace_region(W, S_small, r_v, claimed, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats):
246	    """g1_trace = sum_{lo<=e<=hi} eq(r_v,e) S_small(floor(x/((e+1)p))).
247	    Certify every u_e by the step-1 trace zero-test, then route the masked
248	    small-side lookup. The band mask T(e)=[lo<=e<=hi] zeroes the affine /
249	    padding columns (whose u_e exceed V) out of the routing.  The lookup is
250	    over nb-bit values (<= V), taking the LOW nb bits of the certified u_e,
251	    so omega / S_small stay sqrt x.  Returns (ok, r_B, s_B)."""
252	    if not verify_constraints(W, rng, stats):
253	        return False, None, None
254	    D, Lv = W["D"], W["Lv"]
255	    e = np.arange(D, dtype=np.int64)
256	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
257	    Tband = ((e >= lo) & (e <= hi)).astype(np.uint64)
258	    eqr = eq_table(r_v)
259	    weight = (eqr * Tband) % Q
260	    mask = (1 << nb) - 1
261	    vlow = (W["u"] & mask).astype(np.int64)                 # low nb bits of u_e
262	    omega = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
263	    np.add.at(omega, vlow, weight)                          # < D summands < Q
264	    omega %= Q
265	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
266	
267	    # B1 (deg 2, v-cube): claimed = sum_v S_small(v) omega(v)
268	    okB1, r_B, finalB1, sB1 = sumcheck(claimed,
269	                                       {"S": S_small.copy(), "W": omega.copy()},
270	                                       [(1, ["S", "W"])], 2, rng)
271	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
272	    if not okB1:
273	        return False, None, None
274	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
275	    okf = ((finalB1 % Q) == sB1["S"] * sB1["W"] % Q
276	           and sB1["S"] == mle_eval(S_small, r_B))          # opening of S_small
277	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
278	    if not okf:
279	        return False, None, None
280	
281	    # B2 (deg nb+2, e-cube): sB1[W] = sum_e eq(r_v,e) T(e) prod_k EB_k(e),
282	    #   EB_k = eq(r_B[k], Ub_{Lv-nb+k})  (the LOW nb bits of the SAME u_e).
283	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
284	    tabs = {"EQ": eq_table(r_v), "T": Tband.copy()}
285	    ebn, jidx = [], []
286	    for k in range(nb):
287	        j = Lv - nb + k
288	        jidx.append(j)
289	        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
290	        Ub = W["tabs"][f"Ub{j}"].astype(np.uint64)
291	        tabs[f"EB{k}"] = (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * Ub) % Q
292	        ebn.append(f"EB{k}")
293	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
294	    okB2, r_C, finalB2, _ = sumcheck(sB1["W"], tabs,
295	                                     [(1, ["EQ", "T"] + ebn)], nb + 2, rng)
296	    stats["comm"] += (nb + 3) * nb
297	    if not okB2:
298	        return False, None, None
299	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
300	    expect = eq_point(r_v, r_C) * band_eval(r_C, lo, hi, nb) % Q
301	    for k in range(nb):
302	        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
303	        ub = mle_eval(W["tabs"][f"Ub{jidx[k]}"], r_C)       # opening of Ub_j
304	        expect = expect * (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * ub) % Q
305	    ok = (finalB2 % Q) == expect
306	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
307	    return ok, r_B, sB1["S"]

314	def line_batch_pair(S, pt0, val0, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats):
315	    """Reduce val0=S~(pt0), val1=S~(pt1) to ONE claim (new_pt, new_claim) via
316	    the degree-nb line restriction h(t)=S~((1-t)pt0+t pt1). Endpoint checks
317	    anchor a false input; new_claim is closed by mle_eval (the PCS stand-in)."""
318	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
319	    hs = []
320	    for t in range(nb + 1):
321	        tf = t % Q
322	        gp = [((Q + 1 - tf) * int(a) + tf * int(b)) % Q
323	              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
324	        hs.append(mle_eval(S, gp))
325	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
326	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
327	    ok = hs[0] == val0 and hs[1] == val1
328	    tstar = int(rng.integers(0, Q))
329	    new_claim = lagrange_eval(hs, tstar)
330	    new_pt = [((Q + 1 - tstar) * int(a) + tstar * int(b)) % Q
331	              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
332	    ok = ok and new_claim == mle_eval(S, new_pt)            # leaf close
333	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
334	    stats["comm"] += nb + 1
335	    return new_pt, new_claim, ok

338	def batch_on_table(S, claims, nb, rng, stats):
339	    """Fold k same-table point-claims into one by sequential line restriction.
340	    claims: list of (point, value). Returns (point, value, ok)."""
341	    pt, val = claims[0]
342	    if len(claims) == 1:                                    # still anchor it
343	        t0 = time.perf_counter()
344	        ok = val == mle_eval(S, pt)
345	        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
346	        return pt, val, ok
347	    ok = True
348	    for (pt1, val1) in claims[1:]:
349	        pt, val, okp = line_batch_pair(S, pt, val, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats)
350	        ok = ok and okp
351	    return pt, val, ok

358	def pad(tab, nb):
359	    out = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
360	    a = (np.asarray(tab, dtype=np.int64) % Q).astype(np.uint64)
361	    out[:len(a)] = a
362	    return out

365	def large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, z, C,
366	                 rng, stats, cheat=None):
367	    """Reduce S~_i^large(z)=C to: a large point-claim (new_z,new_claim) on
368	    S_{i-1}^large (line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a small point-claim
369	    (r_B,s_B) on S_{i-1}^small (trace region). cheat in
370	    {None,'G','split','u','waff'}; 'wrong_C'/'delta_pi' handled by callers via C."""
371	    V = isqrt(x)
372	    ci = sp % Q
373	    lo, hi = ecut + 1, V - 1
374	    Bcut = min(V - 1, x // (p * p) - 1)
375	    Dml = 1 << nb
376	
377	    # prover-committed G table over the e-cube
378	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
379	    G = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
380	    for e in range(V):
381	        ep = (e + 1) * p
382	        G[e] = S_prev_large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else S_prev_small[x // ep]
383	    if cheat == "G":
384	        G[0] = (int(G[0]) + 1) % Q
385	    Bf = (np.arange(Dml) <= Bcut).astype(np.uint64)
386	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
387	
388	    # ---- phase A ----
389	    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
390	    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
391	                                          "S": S_prev_large.copy(),
392	                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": G.copy()},
393	                                      termsA, 3, rng)
394	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
395	    if not okA:
396	        return dict(accepted=False)
397	    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
398	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
399	    bv = le_eval(r_v, Bcut, nb)
400	    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
401	    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
402	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
403	    if not okA2:
404	        return dict(accepted=False)
405	
406	    # ---- honest split of g1 ----
407	    eqrv_full = eq_table(r_v)
408	    g1_aff = 0
409	    for e in range(ecut + 1):
410	        g1_aff = (g1_aff + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_large[(e + 1) * p - 1])) % Q
411	    g1_trace = 0
412	    for e in range(lo, hi + 1):
413	        g1_trace = (g1_trace + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_small[x // ((e + 1) * p)])) % Q
414	    if cheat == "split":
415	        g1_aff = (g1_aff + 1) % Q
416	        g1_trace = (g1_trace - 1) % Q
417	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
418	    ok_sum = (g1_aff + g1_trace) % Q == g1 % Q
419	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
420	    if not ok_sum:
421	        return dict(accepted=False)
422	
423	    # ---- affine region ----
424	    okAff, r_u, s2_aff = verify_affine_region(
425	        S_prev_large, r_v, g1_aff, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
426	        cheat=(cheat == "waff"))
427	    if not okAff:
428	        return dict(accepted=False)
429	
430	    # ---- trace region ----
431	    W = build_witness(x, p, nb, dstart=1)
432	    if cheat == "u":                                        # wrong quotient in trace
433	        d = max(lo, 1) % W["D"]
434	        W["tabs"]["U"] = W["tabs"]["U"].copy()
435	        W["tabs"]["U"][d] = (int(W["tabs"]["U"][d]) + 1) % Q
436	    okTr, r_B, s_B = verify_trace_region(
437	        W, S_prev_small, r_v, g1_trace, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats)
438	    if not okTr:
439	        return dict(accepted=False)
440	
441	    # ---- line-batch s1@r_v and s2_aff@r_u (both on S_prev_large) ----
442	    new_z, new_claim, okL = line_batch_pair(
443	        S_prev_large, r_v, s1, r_u, s2_aff, nb, rng, stats)
444	    if not okL:
445	        return dict(accepted=False)
446	
447	    return dict(accepted=True, s_B=s_B, r_B=r_B,
448	                new_claim=new_claim, new_z=new_z, r_v=r_v)
449

451	def small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z, C, rng, stats, cheat=None):
452	    """Reduce S~_i^small(z)=C to TWO point-claims on S_{i-1}^small:
453	    (r_v,s1) [the v itself] and (r_u,s2) [floor(v/p)]. The wiring v->floor(v/p)
454	    stays entirely small-side (value->value): the existing division automaton.
455	    Gate B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V] is a BAND (the upper bound keeps the recurrence off
456	    the padding). cheat in {None,'small_G','small_u'}; 'small_C' via C."""
457	    V = isqrt(x)
458	    ci = sp % Q
459	    p2 = p * p
460	    Dml = 1 << nb
461	    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)
462	
463	    # ---- phase A: C = sum_v eq(z,v)[S(v) - B(v)(G(v)-ci)] ----
464	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
465	    Bf = ((arange >= p2) & (arange <= V)).astype(np.uint64)     # band [p^2<=v<=V]
466	    Gf = S_prev_small[arange // p].astype(np.uint64).copy()     # G(v)=S(floor(v/p))
467	    if cheat == "small_G":
468	        gi = (p2) % Dml
469	        Gf[gi] = (int(Gf[gi]) + 1) % Q
470	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
471	    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
472	    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
473	                                          "S": S_prev_small.copy(),
474	                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": Gf.copy()},
475	                                      termsA, 3, rng)
476	    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
477	    if not okA:
478	        return dict(accepted=False)
479	    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
480	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
481	    bv = band_eval(r_v, p2, V, nb)
482	    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
483	    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
484	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
485	    if not okA2:
486	        return dict(accepted=False)
487	
488	    # ---- phase B: g1 = sum_u W(r_v,u) S(u),  W(v,u)=[u=floor(v/p)] ----
489	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
490	    Wt = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
491	    np.add.at(Wt, arange // p, eq_table(r_v))               # < p summands < Q
492	    Wt %= Q
493	    if cheat == "small_u":
494	        Wt[0] = (int(Wt[0]) + 1) % Q
495	    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
496	    okB, r_u, finalB, scalB = sumcheck(g1, {"W": Wt, "S": S_prev_small.copy()},
497	                                       [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
498	    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
499	    if not okB:
500	        return dict(accepted=False)
501	    s2 = scalB["S"]
502	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
503	    wv = w_div_eval(r_v, r_u, p, nb)
504	    okB2 = (finalB % Q) == wv * s2 % Q
505	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
506	    if not okB2:
507	        return dict(accepted=False)
508	
509	    return dict(accepted=True, claims=[(r_v, s1), (r_u, s2)])

553	def run_two_sided_layer(x, layer, rng, cheat=None):
554	    """Verify ONE full two-sided layer: (large-claim, small-claim) ->
555	    (large-claim', small-claim'). Small-side claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B
556	    from the large trace + the two from the small layer) are folded to one."""
557	    V = isqrt(x)
558	    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
559	    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
560	    assert 1 <= layer <= len(primes)
561	    p = primes[layer - 1]
562	    sp = sm_layers[layer - 1][p - 1]
563	    ecut = V // p - 1
564	    S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[layer - 1], nb)
565	    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)
566	    S_i_large = pad(lg_layers[layer], nb)
567	    S_i_small = pad(sm_layers[layer], nb)
568	    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
569	
570	    zL = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
571	    zS = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
572	    CL = mle_eval(S_i_large, zL)
573	    CS = mle_eval(S_i_small, zS)
574	    if cheat == "wrong_C":
575	        CL = (CL + 1) % Q
576	    if cheat == "small_C":
577	        CS = (CS + 1) % Q
578	
579	    lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, zL, CL,
580	                        rng, stats,
581	                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("G", "split", "u", "waff")
582	                               else None))
583	    if not lres["accepted"]:
584	        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
585	    sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, zS, CS, rng, stats,
586	                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("small_G", "small_u")
587	                               else None))
588	    if not sres["accepted"]:
589	        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
590	
591	    sB = lres["s_B"]
592	    if cheat == "carry":                                    # tamper cross-side carry
593	        sB = (sB + 1) % Q
594	    small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], sB)] + sres["claims"]
595	    zS2, CS2, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims, nb, rng, stats)
596	
597	    out_ok = (okb
598	              and CS2 == mle_eval(S_prev_small, zS2)
599	              and lres["new_claim"] == mle_eval(S_prev_large, lres["new_z"]))
600	    return dict(accepted=out_ok, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut,
601	                CS2=CS2, zS2=zS2, new_claim=lres["new_claim"],
602	                new_z=lres["new_z"], S_prev_small=S_prev_small,
603	                S_prev_large=S_prev_large, **stats)

610	def run_chain(x, rng, cheat=None, corrupt_layer=None):
611	    """Chain all K layers from S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) down to S_0 (opened on
612	    both sides). cheat='delta_pi' lies about pi(x); corrupt_layer=i0 is a
613	    self-consistent liar. Returns dict(accepted, claimed, layers, ...)."""
614	    V = isqrt(x)
615	    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
616	    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
617	    K = len(primes)
618	    if corrupt_layer is not None:
619	        sm_layers, lg_layers = corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers,
620	                                                  lg_layers, x, corrupt_layer)
621	    claimed_pi = lg_layers[K][0]
622	    if cheat == "delta_pi":
623	        claimed_pi += 1
624	
625	    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
626	    z_large = [0] * nb                                       # Boolean point e=0
627	    C_large = claimed_pi % Q
628	    z_small, C_small = None, None
629	
630	    def fail():
631	        return dict(accepted=False, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)
632	
633	    for i in range(K, 0, -1):
634	        p = primes[i - 1]
635	        sp = sm_layers[i - 1][p - 1]
636	        ecut = V // p - 1
637	        S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[i - 1], nb)
638	        S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[i - 1], nb)
639	
640	        lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large,
641	                            z_large, C_large, rng, stats)
642	        if not lres["accepted"]:
643	            return fail()
644	        small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], lres["s_B"])]
645	        if C_small is not None:                             # skipped at i=K
646	            sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z_small, C_small,
647	                                rng, stats)
648	            if not sres["accepted"]:
649	                return fail()
650	            small_claims += sres["claims"]
651	        z_small, C_small, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims,
652	                                               nb, rng, stats)
653	        if not okb:
654	            return fail()
655	        z_large, C_large = lres["new_z"], lres["new_claim"]
656	
657	    # base: open S_0 on both sides (leaf-opening stand-in, O(sqrt x) once)
658	    t0 = time.perf_counter()
659	    S0_large = pad(lg_layers[0], nb)
660	    S0_small = pad(sm_layers[0], nb)
661	    ok = (C_large == mle_eval(S0_large, z_large)
662	          and C_small == mle_eval(S0_small, z_small))
663	    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
664	    return dict(accepted=ok, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)

671	def sieve_pi(x):
672	    s = np.ones(x + 1, dtype=bool)
673	    s[:2] = False
674	    for q in range(2, isqrt(x) + 1):
675	        if s[q]:
676	            s[q * q::q] = False
677	    return int(s.sum())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
compressed_layer.py — S493/S494, compressed-prover steps 2 & 3.

Step 1 (compressed_prover_mult_trace.py) built, in isolation, the batched
multiplication-trace sum-check that certifies a small-side value lookup
C = sum_d eq(rho,d) S~(floor(X/(d p))) with a polylog verifier that never
divides. Step 2 (S493) integrated it into ONE large-side Lucy layer over the
compressed O(sqrt x)-size state. Step 3 (S494, THIS file) adds the SMALL-side
layer and CHAINS all K layers into an end-to-end verification of pi(x) over
the compressed state -- the gate to a production Õ(sqrt x) prover (the demo
prover of lucy_dp_verification materializes the full 2^n table, Õ(x^{3/2})).

The compressed Lucy_Hedgehog key-value DP, V = floor(sqrt x), nb = bits(V):
  small[v]  = S(v)              value-addressed,  v in [1, V]   (index = value)
  large[e]  = S(floor(x/(e+1))) d-addressed,      e in [0, V-1] (index e = d-1)
and pi(x) = large[0] after sieving by every prime <= V. Both sides are padded
to the nb-cube of size 2^nb (V < 2^nb <= 2V); padding entries are 0 every
layer.

The layer recurrence S_i(w) = S_{i-1}(w) - [w>=p^2]*(S_{i-1}(floor(w/p))-(i-1)).

LARGE side (key w = floor(x/(e+1)), step 2): floor(w/p)=floor(x/((e+1)p)).
With ep=(e+1)p, ep<=V is an AFFINE large-index map e->ep-1 (long-division
automaton waff_eval, no trace); ep>V is a SMALL value looked up by value
WITHOUT the verifier dividing -- step 1's trace primitive. Phase-A folds
validity AND the p^2 gate into ONE threshold B(e)=[e<=Bcut]; phase-B splits
g1=g1_aff+g1_trace and dispatches per key. Outputs: a large point-claim
(line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a SMALL point-claim s_B@r_B (carried).

SMALL side (key w = v, step 3, NEW): floor(w/p)=floor(v/p) stays ENTIRELY
within the small side (value->value) -- the existing division automaton
w_div_eval / lucy_dp_verification.verify_layer phase-B over the nb-cube. The
gate is a BAND B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V]: the upper bound [v<=V] is load-bearing in
general (it keeps the recurrence off the padding columns whose update would
otherwise corrupt the zero padding); when V=2^nb-1 (x=2^n-1, n even) the band
collapses to the bare comparator [v>=p^2] of the NEXT-ACTION note -- so the
"comparator suffices, no validity fold" claim holds exactly in the no-padding
case and the band is its general-V refinement. The small layer emits TWO
point-claims on S_{i-1}^small: s1@r_v (the v itself) and s2@r_u (floor(v/p)).

CHAIN (step 3). Per layer we carry a width-2 claim vector
(large-claim about S_i^large, small-claim about S_i^small). Start: layer K
has only large-claim S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) (no S_K^small is referenced).
Running layer i:
  * large_reduce consumes the large-claim -> a large-claim about S_{i-1}^large
    AND a small-claim s_B about S_{i-1}^small (its trace region);
  * small_reduce (skipped at i=K) consumes the small-claim -> two small-claims
    about S_{i-1}^small.
The same-table claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B + the two from small_reduce)
are folded by sequential LINE restriction into one; the large-claim is its own
line-batch. Base: open S_0 on both sides. Soundness: a self-consistent liar
(corrupt one DP entry, re-propagate upward) is caught at the layer where the
corruption meets the honest layer below -- phase-A's round-1 sum on the honest
S_{i-1} tables disagrees with the corrupted carried claim.

Leaf openings of committed tables (incl. the two S_0 bases) are closed here by
direct MLE evaluation -- the stand-in for the polynomial-commitment / outer-
protocol line batching, identical to steps 1-2's scope. The S_0 bases have no
cheap closed form (floor(x/(e+1)) on the large side; padded max(v-1,0) on the
small side), so they are opened directly: a ONE-TIME O(sqrt x), within the
Õ(sqrt x) budget. The reduction logic is real: every per-layer check is a
genuine MLE-consistency test against true wiring (eq, band/threshold
comparators, division & affine automata); honest accepts, every cheating
prover is rejected.

Sizes (the point of the line): small & large cubes 2^nb ~ sqrt x; the trace
constraint test runs on the e-cube with Lv=O(log x) bit tables -> prover
Õ(sqrt x); verifier touches only nb-length points and O(nb)-state automata
(except waff's O(nb*p), delegatable to O(nb*log p)).

What would falsify this: the compressed DP disagreeing with a sieve; an honest
layer or honest chain rejected; output/base claims not equal to the true MLEs;
any cheating prover (corrupted DP claim/table, wrong region split, wrong trace
quotient, wrong affine image, corrupted small-side wiring, tampered cross-side
carry, wrong claimed pi) accepted above the field soundness bound; or verifier
work scaling with 2^n instead of nb.

Usage:
  python3 compressed_layer.py --selftest
  python3 compressed_layer.py --n 12 --cheat-trials 20
  python3 compressed_layer.py --bench
"""

import argparse
import time
from math import isqrt

import numpy as np

from lucy_dp_verification import (Q, lagrange_eval, eq_table, eq_point,
                                  mle_eval, ge_const_eval, w_div_eval, sumcheck)
from compressed_prover_mult_trace import build_witness, verify_constraints


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# the compressed Lucy_Hedgehog DP (prover substrate), all layers, exact
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def compressed_lucy(x):
    """Return (primes, small_layers, large_layers).
    small_layers[i][v] = S_i(v) for v in [0,V];  small_layers[0] = S_0.
    large_layers[i][e] = S_i(floor(x/(e+1))) for e in [0,V).
    pi(x) = large_layers[-1][0]."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    small = [max(v - 1, 0) for v in range(V + 1)]
    large = [(x // (e + 1)) - 1 for e in range(V)]
    small_layers, large_layers, primes = [small[:]], [large[:]], []
    for p in range(2, V + 1):
        if small[p] - small[p - 1] > 0:                     # p is prime
            primes.append(p)
            sp, p2 = small[p - 1], p * p
            ns, nl = small[:], large[:]
            for v in range(p2, V + 1):
                ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
            for e in range(V):
                val = x // (e + 1)
                if val >= p2:
                    ep = (e + 1) * p
                    sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
                    nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
            small, large = ns, nl
            small_layers.append(small[:])
            large_layers.append(large[:])
    return primes, small_layers, large_layers


def corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers, lg_layers, x, i0):
    """Self-consistent liar: corrupt large_layers[i0][0] (the pi-carrying
    slot, = S_{i0}(x)) and re-propagate layers i0+1..K so the corrupted tables
    are mutually consistent. The small side is unchanged (its recurrence never
    reads the large side), so the corruption is large-only and must be caught
    at layer i0 where it meets the honest layer i0-1 below."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    K = len(primes)
    sm = [s[:] for s in sm_layers]
    lg = [l[:] for l in lg_layers]
    lg[i0][0] = lg[i0][0] + 1
    small, large = sm[i0][:], lg[i0][:]
    for j in range(i0 + 1, K + 1):
        p = primes[j - 1]
        sp, p2 = small[p - 1], p * p
        ns, nl = small[:], large[:]
        for v in range(p2, V + 1):
            ns[v] = small[v] - (small[v // p] - sp)
        for e in range(V):
            val = x // (e + 1)
            if val >= p2:
                ep = (e + 1) * p
                sval = large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else small[val // p]
                nl[e] = large[e] - (sval - sp)
        small, large = ns, nl
        sm[j], lg[j] = small[:], large[:]
    return sm, lg


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# verifier-side O(nb) threshold MLEs and the O(nb*p) affine-wiring MLE
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def le_eval(r, M, n):
    """MLE of [e <= M] on n-bit e at point r. O(n)."""
    if M < 0:
        return 0
    if M >= (1 << n) - 1:
        return 1
    return (Q + 1 - ge_const_eval(r, M + 1, n)) % Q


def band_eval(r, lo, hi, n):
    """MLE of [lo <= e <= hi].  [lo<=e<=hi] = [e<=hi] - [e<=lo-1] pointwise,
    and the MLE is linear over that pointwise difference. O(n).  An EMPTY band
    (lo > hi, e.g. the small-side gate when p^2 > V) is the all-zero indicator,
    whose MLE is 0 -- and le(hi)-le(lo-1) is NOT 0 there, so guard it."""
    if lo > hi:
        return 0
    return (le_eval(r, hi, n) - le_eval(r, lo - 1, n)) % Q


def waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, n):
    """MLE of the affine-region wiring W_aff(e, e') = [e <= ecut] * [e' = p*e
    + (p-1)] at (r_v over e, r_u over e').  e' = p*e+(p-1) <=> floor(e'/p)=e
    AND e' mod p = p-1, so a long-division automaton on e' (state = running
    remainder in [0,p)) whose emitted quotient bits must equal e, accepting
    on final remainder p-1, crossed with a 3-state comparator e<=ecut.
    Bits MSB-first. VERIFIER: O(n*p)."""
    st = {(0, 0): 1}                       # (remainder, cmp) -> weight; cmp 0=eq 1=gt 2=lt
    for j in range(n):
        cbit = (ecut >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1
        wv = [(Q + 1 - int(r_v[j])) % Q, int(r_v[j]) % Q]   # e bit
        wu = [(Q + 1 - int(r_u[j])) % Q, int(r_u[j]) % Q]   # e' bit
        new = {}
        for (rem, cmp), w in st.items():
            if w == 0:
                continue
            for epb in (0, 1):
                t = 2 * rem + epb
                qb, rem2 = divmod(t, p)
                if qb > 1:                 # quotient bit out of range -> dead
                    continue
                cmp2 = (cmp if cmp != 0 else
                        (1 if qb > cbit else 2 if qb < cbit else 0))
                wgt = w * wu[epb] % Q * wv[qb] % Q          # eb := qb (forced)
                key = (rem2, cmp2)
                new[key] = (new.get(key, 0) + wgt) % Q
        st = new
    return sum(w for (rem, cmp), w in st.items()
               if rem == p - 1 and cmp in (0, 2)) % Q       # e <= ecut


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# region verifiers (large side)
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def verify_affine_region(S_large, r_v, claimed, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
                         cheat=False):
    """g1_aff = sum_{e<=ecut} eq(r_v,e) S_large((e+1)p-1).  Routed by image
    index e': g1_aff = sum_{e'} Waff[e'] S_large(e').  Returns (ok, r_u, s2)."""
    Dml = 1 << nb
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
    Waff = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
    for e in range(ecut + 1):
        ep1 = (e + 1) * p - 1
        if ep1 < Dml:
            Waff[ep1] = (int(Waff[ep1]) + int(eqrv[e])) % Q
    if cheat:                                               # wrong affine image
        bad = (p) % Dml
        Waff[bad] = (int(Waff[bad]) + 1) % Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    okB, r_u, finalB, scal = sumcheck(claimed,
                                      {"W": Waff.copy(), "S": S_large.copy()},
                                      [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
    if not okB:
        return False, None, None
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    waffv = waff_eval(r_v, r_u, p, ecut, nb)
    s2 = scal["S"]
    ok = (finalB % Q) == waffv * s2 % Q and s2 == mle_eval(S_large, r_u)
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    return ok, r_u, s2


def verify_trace_region(W, S_small, r_v, claimed, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats):
    """g1_trace = sum_{lo<=e<=hi} eq(r_v,e) S_small(floor(x/((e+1)p))).
    Certify every u_e by the step-1 trace zero-test, then route the masked
    small-side lookup. The band mask T(e)=[lo<=e<=hi] zeroes the affine /
    padding columns (whose u_e exceed V) out of the routing.  The lookup is
    over nb-bit values (<= V), taking the LOW nb bits of the certified u_e,
    so omega / S_small stay sqrt x.  Returns (ok, r_B, s_B)."""
    if not verify_constraints(W, rng, stats):
        return False, None, None
    D, Lv = W["D"], W["Lv"]
    e = np.arange(D, dtype=np.int64)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    Tband = ((e >= lo) & (e <= hi)).astype(np.uint64)
    eqr = eq_table(r_v)
    weight = (eqr * Tband) % Q
    mask = (1 << nb) - 1
    vlow = (W["u"] & mask).astype(np.int64)                 # low nb bits of u_e
    omega = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
    np.add.at(omega, vlow, weight)                          # < D summands < Q
    omega %= Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0

    # B1 (deg 2, v-cube): claimed = sum_v S_small(v) omega(v)
    okB1, r_B, finalB1, sB1 = sumcheck(claimed,
                                       {"S": S_small.copy(), "W": omega.copy()},
                                       [(1, ["S", "W"])], 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
    if not okB1:
        return False, None, None
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    okf = ((finalB1 % Q) == sB1["S"] * sB1["W"] % Q
           and sB1["S"] == mle_eval(S_small, r_B))          # opening of S_small
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okf:
        return False, None, None

    # B2 (deg nb+2, e-cube): sB1[W] = sum_e eq(r_v,e) T(e) prod_k EB_k(e),
    #   EB_k = eq(r_B[k], Ub_{Lv-nb+k})  (the LOW nb bits of the SAME u_e).
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    tabs = {"EQ": eq_table(r_v), "T": Tband.copy()}
    ebn, jidx = [], []
    for k in range(nb):
        j = Lv - nb + k
        jidx.append(j)
        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
        Ub = W["tabs"][f"Ub{j}"].astype(np.uint64)
        tabs[f"EB{k}"] = (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * Ub) % Q
        ebn.append(f"EB{k}")
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    okB2, r_C, finalB2, _ = sumcheck(sB1["W"], tabs,
                                     [(1, ["EQ", "T"] + ebn)], nb + 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += (nb + 3) * nb
    if not okB2:
        return False, None, None
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    expect = eq_point(r_v, r_C) * band_eval(r_C, lo, hi, nb) % Q
    for k in range(nb):
        rb = int(r_B[k]) % Q
        ub = mle_eval(W["tabs"][f"Ub{jidx[k]}"], r_C)       # opening of Ub_j
        expect = expect * (((1 - rb) % Q) + ((2 * rb - 1) % Q) * ub) % Q
    ok = (finalB2 % Q) == expect
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    return ok, r_B, sB1["S"]


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# claim aggregation: fold same-table point-claims by line restriction
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def line_batch_pair(S, pt0, val0, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats):
    """Reduce val0=S~(pt0), val1=S~(pt1) to ONE claim (new_pt, new_claim) via
    the degree-nb line restriction h(t)=S~((1-t)pt0+t pt1). Endpoint checks
    anchor a false input; new_claim is closed by mle_eval (the PCS stand-in)."""
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    hs = []
    for t in range(nb + 1):
        tf = t % Q
        gp = [((Q + 1 - tf) * int(a) + tf * int(b)) % Q
              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
        hs.append(mle_eval(S, gp))
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    ok = hs[0] == val0 and hs[1] == val1
    tstar = int(rng.integers(0, Q))
    new_claim = lagrange_eval(hs, tstar)
    new_pt = [((Q + 1 - tstar) * int(a) + tstar * int(b)) % Q
              for a, b in zip(pt0, pt1)]
    ok = ok and new_claim == mle_eval(S, new_pt)            # leaf close
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    stats["comm"] += nb + 1
    return new_pt, new_claim, ok


def batch_on_table(S, claims, nb, rng, stats):
    """Fold k same-table point-claims into one by sequential line restriction.
    claims: list of (point, value). Returns (point, value, ok)."""
    pt, val = claims[0]
    if len(claims) == 1:                                    # still anchor it
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        ok = val == mle_eval(S, pt)
        stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
        return pt, val, ok
    ok = True
    for (pt1, val1) in claims[1:]:
        pt, val, okp = line_batch_pair(S, pt, val, pt1, val1, nb, rng, stats)
        ok = ok and okp
    return pt, val, ok


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# one compressed layer, each side
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def pad(tab, nb):
    out = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
    a = (np.asarray(tab, dtype=np.int64) % Q).astype(np.uint64)
    out[:len(a)] = a
    return out


def large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, z, C,
                 rng, stats, cheat=None):
    """Reduce S~_i^large(z)=C to: a large point-claim (new_z,new_claim) on
    S_{i-1}^large (line-batched s1@r_v + s2_aff@r_u) and a small point-claim
    (r_B,s_B) on S_{i-1}^small (trace region). cheat in
    {None,'G','split','u','waff'}; 'wrong_C'/'delta_pi' handled by callers via C."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    ci = sp % Q
    lo, hi = ecut + 1, V - 1
    Bcut = min(V - 1, x // (p * p) - 1)
    Dml = 1 << nb

    # prover-committed G table over the e-cube
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    G = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
    for e in range(V):
        ep = (e + 1) * p
        G[e] = S_prev_large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else S_prev_small[x // ep]
    if cheat == "G":
        G[0] = (int(G[0]) + 1) % Q
    Bf = (np.arange(Dml) <= Bcut).astype(np.uint64)
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0

    # ---- phase A ----
    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
                                          "S": S_prev_large.copy(),
                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": G.copy()},
                                      termsA, 3, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
    if not okA:
        return dict(accepted=False)
    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    bv = le_eval(r_v, Bcut, nb)
    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okA2:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- honest split of g1 ----
    eqrv_full = eq_table(r_v)
    g1_aff = 0
    for e in range(ecut + 1):
        g1_aff = (g1_aff + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_large[(e + 1) * p - 1])) % Q
    g1_trace = 0
    for e in range(lo, hi + 1):
        g1_trace = (g1_trace + int(eqrv_full[e]) * int(S_prev_small[x // ((e + 1) * p)])) % Q
    if cheat == "split":
        g1_aff = (g1_aff + 1) % Q
        g1_trace = (g1_trace - 1) % Q
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    ok_sum = (g1_aff + g1_trace) % Q == g1 % Q
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not ok_sum:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- affine region ----
    okAff, r_u, s2_aff = verify_affine_region(
        S_prev_large, r_v, g1_aff, p, ecut, nb, rng, stats,
        cheat=(cheat == "waff"))
    if not okAff:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- trace region ----
    W = build_witness(x, p, nb, dstart=1)
    if cheat == "u":                                        # wrong quotient in trace
        d = max(lo, 1) % W["D"]
        W["tabs"]["U"] = W["tabs"]["U"].copy()
        W["tabs"]["U"][d] = (int(W["tabs"]["U"][d]) + 1) % Q
    okTr, r_B, s_B = verify_trace_region(
        W, S_prev_small, r_v, g1_trace, lo, hi, nb, rng, stats)
    if not okTr:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- line-batch s1@r_v and s2_aff@r_u (both on S_prev_large) ----
    new_z, new_claim, okL = line_batch_pair(
        S_prev_large, r_v, s1, r_u, s2_aff, nb, rng, stats)
    if not okL:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    return dict(accepted=True, s_B=s_B, r_B=r_B,
                new_claim=new_claim, new_z=new_z, r_v=r_v)


def small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z, C, rng, stats, cheat=None):
    """Reduce S~_i^small(z)=C to TWO point-claims on S_{i-1}^small:
    (r_v,s1) [the v itself] and (r_u,s2) [floor(v/p)]. The wiring v->floor(v/p)
    stays entirely small-side (value->value): the existing division automaton.
    Gate B(v)=[p^2<=v<=V] is a BAND (the upper bound keeps the recurrence off
    the padding). cheat in {None,'small_G','small_u'}; 'small_C' via C."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    ci = sp % Q
    p2 = p * p
    Dml = 1 << nb
    arange = np.arange(Dml, dtype=np.int64)

    # ---- phase A: C = sum_v eq(z,v)[S(v) - B(v)(G(v)-ci)] ----
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    Bf = ((arange >= p2) & (arange <= V)).astype(np.uint64)     # band [p^2<=v<=V]
    Gf = S_prev_small[arange // p].astype(np.uint64).copy()     # G(v)=S(floor(v/p))
    if cheat == "small_G":
        gi = (p2) % Dml
        Gf[gi] = (int(Gf[gi]) + 1) % Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    termsA = [(1, ["EQ", "S"]), (Q - 1, ["EQ", "B", "G"]), (ci, ["EQ", "B"])]
    okA, r_v, finalA, scal = sumcheck(C, {"EQ": eq_table(z),
                                          "S": S_prev_small.copy(),
                                          "B": Bf.copy(), "G": Gf.copy()},
                                      termsA, 3, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 4 * nb
    if not okA:
        return dict(accepted=False)
    s1, g1 = scal["S"], scal["G"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    bv = band_eval(r_v, p2, V, nb)
    expect = eq_point(z, r_v) * ((s1 - bv * ((g1 - ci) % Q)) % Q) % Q
    okA2 = (finalA % Q) == expect
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okA2:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    # ---- phase B: g1 = sum_u W(r_v,u) S(u),  W(v,u)=[u=floor(v/p)] ----
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    Wt = np.zeros(Dml, dtype=np.uint64)
    np.add.at(Wt, arange // p, eq_table(r_v))               # < p summands < Q
    Wt %= Q
    if cheat == "small_u":
        Wt[0] = (int(Wt[0]) + 1) % Q
    stats["t_prover"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    okB, r_u, finalB, scalB = sumcheck(g1, {"W": Wt, "S": S_prev_small.copy()},
                                       [(1, ["W", "S"])], 2, rng)
    stats["comm"] += 3 * nb
    if not okB:
        return dict(accepted=False)
    s2 = scalB["S"]
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    wv = w_div_eval(r_v, r_u, p, nb)
    okB2 = (finalB % Q) == wv * s2 % Q
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    if not okB2:
        return dict(accepted=False)

    return dict(accepted=True, claims=[(r_v, s1), (r_u, s2)])


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# single-layer test drivers
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def _result(accepted, x, p, C, stats, nb, ecut, **extra):
    d = dict(accepted=accepted, x=x, p=p, C=C, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
    d.update(extra)
    return d


def run_layer(x, layer, rng, z=None, cheat=None):
    """Verify ONE large-side compressed layer (step-2 single-layer test).
    cheat in {None, wrong_C, G, split, u, waff}."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
    assert 1 <= layer <= len(primes)
    p = primes[layer - 1]
    sp = sm_layers[layer - 1][p - 1]
    ecut = V // p - 1
    S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_i_large = pad(lg_layers[layer], nb)
    if z is None:
        z = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    C = mle_eval(S_i_large, z)
    if cheat == "wrong_C":
        C = (C + 1) % Q
    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
    res = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, z, C,
                       rng, stats,
                       cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("G", "split", "u", "waff")
                              else None))
    out = _result(res["accepted"], x, p, C, stats, nb, ecut)
    if res["accepted"]:
        out.update(s_B=res["s_B"], r_B=res["r_B"], new_claim=res["new_claim"],
                   new_z=res["new_z"], S_prev_small=S_prev_small,
                   S_prev_large=S_prev_large)
    return out


def run_two_sided_layer(x, layer, rng, cheat=None):
    """Verify ONE full two-sided layer: (large-claim, small-claim) ->
    (large-claim', small-claim'). Small-side claims about S_{i-1}^small (s_B
    from the large trace + the two from the small layer) are folded to one."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
    assert 1 <= layer <= len(primes)
    p = primes[layer - 1]
    sp = sm_layers[layer - 1][p - 1]
    ecut = V // p - 1
    S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[layer - 1], nb)
    S_i_large = pad(lg_layers[layer], nb)
    S_i_small = pad(sm_layers[layer], nb)
    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}

    zL = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    zS = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    CL = mle_eval(S_i_large, zL)
    CS = mle_eval(S_i_small, zS)
    if cheat == "wrong_C":
        CL = (CL + 1) % Q
    if cheat == "small_C":
        CS = (CS + 1) % Q

    lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large, zL, CL,
                        rng, stats,
                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("G", "split", "u", "waff")
                               else None))
    if not lres["accepted"]:
        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)
    sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, zS, CS, rng, stats,
                        cheat=(cheat if cheat in ("small_G", "small_u")
                               else None))
    if not sres["accepted"]:
        return dict(accepted=False, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut, **stats)

    sB = lres["s_B"]
    if cheat == "carry":                                    # tamper cross-side carry
        sB = (sB + 1) % Q
    small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], sB)] + sres["claims"]
    zS2, CS2, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims, nb, rng, stats)

    out_ok = (okb
              and CS2 == mle_eval(S_prev_small, zS2)
              and lres["new_claim"] == mle_eval(S_prev_large, lres["new_z"]))
    return dict(accepted=out_ok, x=x, p=p, nb=nb, ecut=ecut,
                CS2=CS2, zS2=zS2, new_claim=lres["new_claim"],
                new_z=lres["new_z"], S_prev_small=S_prev_small,
                S_prev_large=S_prev_large, **stats)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# the full compressed chain: verify pi(x) end-to-end
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def run_chain(x, rng, cheat=None, corrupt_layer=None):
    """Chain all K layers from S_K^large(e=0)=pi(x) down to S_0 (opened on
    both sides). cheat='delta_pi' lies about pi(x); corrupt_layer=i0 is a
    self-consistent liar. Returns dict(accepted, claimed, layers, ...)."""
    V = isqrt(x)
    nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
    primes, sm_layers, lg_layers = compressed_lucy(x)
    K = len(primes)
    if corrupt_layer is not None:
        sm_layers, lg_layers = corrupt_compressed(primes, sm_layers,
                                                  lg_layers, x, corrupt_layer)
    claimed_pi = lg_layers[K][0]
    if cheat == "delta_pi":
        claimed_pi += 1

    stats = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
    z_large = [0] * nb                                       # Boolean point e=0
    C_large = claimed_pi % Q
    z_small, C_small = None, None

    def fail():
        return dict(accepted=False, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)

    for i in range(K, 0, -1):
        p = primes[i - 1]
        sp = sm_layers[i - 1][p - 1]
        ecut = V // p - 1
        S_prev_small = pad(sm_layers[i - 1], nb)
        S_prev_large = pad(lg_layers[i - 1], nb)

        lres = large_reduce(x, p, sp, ecut, nb, S_prev_small, S_prev_large,
                            z_large, C_large, rng, stats)
        if not lres["accepted"]:
            return fail()
        small_claims = [(lres["r_B"], lres["s_B"])]
        if C_small is not None:                             # skipped at i=K
            sres = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nb, S_prev_small, z_small, C_small,
                                rng, stats)
            if not sres["accepted"]:
                return fail()
            small_claims += sres["claims"]
        z_small, C_small, okb = batch_on_table(S_prev_small, small_claims,
                                               nb, rng, stats)
        if not okb:
            return fail()
        z_large, C_large = lres["new_z"], lres["new_claim"]

    # base: open S_0 on both sides (leaf-opening stand-in, O(sqrt x) once)
    t0 = time.perf_counter()
    S0_large = pad(lg_layers[0], nb)
    S0_small = pad(sm_layers[0], nb)
    ok = (C_large == mle_eval(S0_large, z_large)
          and C_small == mle_eval(S0_small, z_small))
    stats["t_verifier"] += time.perf_counter() - t0
    return dict(accepted=ok, claimed=claimed_pi, layers=K, **stats)


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------
# tests / experiments
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------

def sieve_pi(x):
    s = np.ones(x + 1, dtype=bool)
    s[:2] = False
    for q in range(2, isqrt(x) + 1):
        if s[q]:
            s[q * q::q] = False
    return int(s.sum())


def selftest():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
    # 1. compressed DP == sieve
    for n in range(6, 17):
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        _, _, lg = compressed_lucy(x)
        assert lg[-1][0] == sieve_pi(x), n

    # 2. le / band MLEs vs Boolean truth (exhaustive small n)
    for n in (3, 4, 5):
        for M in range(-1, (1 << n) + 1):
            for e in range(1 << n):
                be = [(e >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                assert le_eval(be, M, n) == (1 if e <= M else 0), (n, M, e)
        for lo in range(0, 1 << n):
            for hi in range(lo, 1 << n):
                for e in range(1 << n):
                    be = [(e >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                    assert band_eval(be, lo, hi, n) == (1 if lo <= e <= hi else 0)
        # empty band (lo>hi, e.g. small-side gate when p^2>V) -> all-zero MLE
        for lo in range(1, 1 << n):
            r = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(n)]
            assert band_eval(r, lo, lo - 1, n) == 0

    # 3. waff_eval vs Boolean truth and vs full-table MLE at random points
    for (n, p) in [(4, 3), (5, 5), (5, 7), (6, 2)]:
        for ecut in (0, 1, (1 << n) // p):
            full = np.zeros(1 << (2 * n), dtype=np.uint64)
            for e in range(1 << n):
                ep1 = p * e + (p - 1)
                if e <= ecut and ep1 < (1 << n):
                    full[(e << n) | ep1] = 1
            for e in range(1 << n):
                for ep in range(1 << n):
                    be = [(e >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                    bp = [(ep >> (n - 1 - j)) & 1 for j in range(n)]
                    want = 1 if (e <= ecut and ep == p * e + (p - 1)) else 0
                    assert waff_eval(be, bp, p, ecut, n) == want, (n, p, ecut, e, ep)
            for _ in range(5):
                rv = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(n)]
                ru = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(n)]
                assert waff_eval(rv, ru, p, ecut, n) == mle_eval(full, rv + ru)

    # 4. honest LARGE layer accepts; output claims equal true MLEs of S_{i-1}
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 2), (10, 4), (12, 3), (12, 5)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        res = run_layer(x, layer, np.random.default_rng(7))
        assert res["accepted"], (n, layer)
        assert res["s_B"] == mle_eval(res["S_prev_small"], res["r_B"])
        assert res["new_claim"] == mle_eval(res["S_prev_large"], res["new_z"])

    # 5. honest g1 == g1_aff + g1_trace decomposition (phase-A / phase-B tie)
    x = (1 << 12) - 1
    V = isqrt(x); nb = V.bit_length()
    primes, sm, lg = compressed_lucy(x)
    p = primes[3]; ecut = V // p - 1; lo, hi = ecut + 1, V - 1
    S_prev_small = pad(sm[3], nb); S_prev_large = pad(lg[3], nb)
    r_v = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nb)]
    eqrv = eq_table(r_v)
    G = np.zeros(1 << nb, dtype=np.uint64)
    for e in range(V):
        ep = (e + 1) * p
        G[e] = S_prev_large[ep - 1] if ep <= V else S_prev_small[x // ep]
    g1 = mle_eval(G, r_v)
    g1a = sum(int(eqrv[e]) * int(S_prev_large[(e + 1) * p - 1])
              for e in range(ecut + 1)) % Q
    g1t = sum(int(eqrv[e]) * int(S_prev_small[x // ((e + 1) * p)])
              for e in range(lo, hi + 1)) % Q
    assert (g1a + g1t) % Q == g1 % Q

    # 6. LARGE-side soundness: every cheat class rejected across primes/layers
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 3), (12, 4), (12, 6)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        for ch in ["wrong_C", "G", "split", "u", "waff"]:
            rej = sum(not run_layer(x, layer, np.random.default_rng(50 + t),
                                    cheat=ch)["accepted"] for t in range(8))
            assert rej == 8, (n, layer, ch, rej)

    # 7. honest SMALL layer accepts; both output claims equal true MLEs.
    #    (also exercises padding via odd n: V != 2^nb-1)
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 2), (11, 3), (12, 4), (12, 6), (13, 5)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        Vv = isqrt(x); nbv = max(1, Vv.bit_length())
        primes, sm, lg = compressed_lucy(x)
        p = primes[layer - 1]
        sp = sm[layer - 1][p - 1]
        Spsmall = pad(sm[layer - 1], nbv)
        Sismall = pad(sm[layer], nbv)
        zS = [int(rng.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nbv)]
        CS = mle_eval(Sismall, zS)
        st = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
        r = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nbv, Spsmall, zS, CS,
                         np.random.default_rng(11 + layer), st)
        assert r["accepted"], (n, layer)
        for (pt, val) in r["claims"]:
            assert val == mle_eval(Spsmall, pt), (n, layer)

    # 8. SMALL-side soundness: small_C / small_G / small_u rejected
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 3), (12, 5), (13, 4)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        Vv = isqrt(x); nbv = max(1, Vv.bit_length())
        primes, sm, lg = compressed_lucy(x)
        p = primes[layer - 1]; sp = sm[layer - 1][p - 1]
        Spsmall = pad(sm[layer - 1], nbv); Sismall = pad(sm[layer], nbv)
        for ch in ["small_C", "small_G", "small_u"]:
            rej = 0
            for t in range(8):
                rr = np.random.default_rng(300 + t)
                zS = [int(rr.integers(0, Q)) for _ in range(nbv)]
                CS = mle_eval(Sismall, zS)
                if ch == "small_C":
                    CS = (CS + 1) % Q
                st = {"t_prover": 0.0, "t_verifier": 0.0, "comm": 0}
                res = small_reduce(x, p, sp, nbv, Spsmall, zS, CS, rr, st,
                                   cheat=(ch if ch != "small_C" else None))
                rej += (not res["accepted"])
            assert rej == 8, (n, layer, ch, rej)

    # 9. honest TWO-SIDED single layer accepts; outputs == true MLEs
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 2), (11, 4), (12, 3), (12, 7)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        res = run_two_sided_layer(x, layer, np.random.default_rng(9 + layer))
        assert res["accepted"], (n, layer)
        assert res["CS2"] == mle_eval(res["S_prev_small"], res["zS2"])
        assert res["new_claim"] == mle_eval(res["S_prev_large"], res["new_z"])

    # 10. TWO-SIDED soundness: every cheat (both sides + carry) rejected
    for (n, layer) in [(10, 3), (12, 5)]:
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        for ch in ["wrong_C", "G", "split", "u", "waff",
                   "small_C", "small_G", "small_u", "carry"]:
            rej = sum(not run_two_sided_layer(x, layer,
                                              np.random.default_rng(400 + t),
                                              cheat=ch)["accepted"]
                      for t in range(6))
            assert rej == 6, (n, layer, ch, rej)

    # 11. honest CHAIN accepts and matches the sieve (incl. odd n / padding)
    for n in (8, 10, 11, 12):
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        res = run_chain(x, np.random.default_rng(5))
        assert res["accepted"] and res["claimed"] == sieve_pi(x), (n, res)

    # 12. CHAIN soundness: delta_pi and self-consistent liar rejected
    for n in (10, 12):
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        K = len(compressed_lucy(x)[0])
        rej = sum(not run_chain(x, np.random.default_rng(600 + t),
                                cheat="delta_pi")["accepted"] for t in range(5))
        assert rej == 5, (n, "delta_pi", rej)
        for i0 in sorted(set([K, max(1, K // 2), 1])):
            rej = sum(not run_chain(x, np.random.default_rng(700 + i0 + t),
                                    corrupt_layer=i0)["accepted"]
                      for t in range(5))
            assert rej == 5, (n, "corrupt", i0, rej)
    print("selftest OK")


def bench():
    print(f"{'n':>3} {'V':>5} {'nb':>3} {'K':>4} {'pi(x)':>7} "
          f"{'t_prover_ms':>12} {'t_verifier_ms':>14} {'comm':>8}")
    for n in (8, 10, 12, 14, 16):
        x = (1 << n) - 1
        res = run_chain(x, np.random.default_rng(n))
        assert res["accepted"] and res["claimed"] == sieve_pi(x)
        print(f"{n:>3} {isqrt(x):>5} {max(1, isqrt(x).bit_length()):>3} "
              f"{res['layers']:>4} {res['claimed']:>7} "
              f"{res['t_prover']*1000:>12.2f} {res['t_verifier']*1000:>14.3f} "
              f"{res['comm']:>8}")


def main(n, layer, cheat_trials, seed):
    x = (1 << n) - 1
    V = isqrt(x); nb = max(1, V.bit_length())
    primes, _, _ = compressed_lucy(x)
    K = len(primes)
    truth = sieve_pi(x)

    # ---- full compressed chain (the headline) ----
    res = run_chain(x, np.random.default_rng(seed))
    print(f"x = 2^{n}-1 = {x}, V = floor(sqrt x) = {V}, compressed cubes "
          f"2^{nb} = {1 << nb}, layers K = {K}")
    print(f"CHAIN honest run: {'ACCEPTED' if res['accepted'] else 'REJECTED'}; "
          f"claimed pi(x) = {res['claimed']}, sieve pi(x) = {truth}, "
          f"match = {res['claimed'] == truth}")
    assert res["accepted"] and res["claimed"] == truth
    print(f"  t_prover = {res['t_prover']*1000:.2f} ms   "
          f"t_verifier = {res['t_verifier']*1000:.3f} ms   "
          f"comm = {res['comm']} field elems (~{res['comm']*4/1024:.1f} KB)")
    rej = sum(not run_chain(x, np.random.default_rng(seed + 10 + t),
                            cheat="delta_pi")["accepted"]
              for t in range(cheat_trials))
    print(f"  chain cheat delta_pi (claim pi+1):           "
          f"rejected {rej}/{cheat_trials}")
    for i0 in sorted(set([K, max(1, K // 2), 1])):
        rej = sum(not run_chain(x, np.random.default_rng(seed + 100 + i0 + t),
                                corrupt_layer=i0)["accepted"]
                  for t in range(cheat_trials))
        print(f"  chain self-consistent liar @ layer {i0:>2}/{K}:        "
              f"rejected {rej}/{cheat_trials}")

    # ---- two-sided single layer cheat panel ----
    if layer is None:
        layer = max(1, K // 2)
    tl = run_two_sided_layer(x, layer, np.random.default_rng(seed))
    print(f"two-sided single layer {layer}/{K} (prime p = {primes[layer-1]}): "
          f"{'ACCEPTED' if tl['accepted'] else 'REJECTED'}")
    assert tl["accepted"]
    for ch in ["wrong_C", "G", "split", "u", "waff",
               "small_C", "small_G", "small_u", "carry"]:
        rej = sum(not run_two_sided_layer(x, layer,
                                          np.random.default_rng(seed + 30 + t),
                                          cheat=ch)["accepted"]
                  for t in range(cheat_trials))
        print(f"  layer cheat {ch:>8}: rejected {rej}/{cheat_trials}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--n", type=int, default=12)
    ap.add_argument("--layer", type=int, default=None)
    ap.add_argument("--cheat-trials", type=int, default=20)
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=1)
    ap.add_argument("--selftest", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--bench", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()
    if args.selftest:
        selftest()
    elif args.bench:
        bench()
    else:
        main(args.n, args.layer, args.cheat_trials, args.seed)
